name: the-safe
title: The Safe
description: A solid combination safe in SVG, on levelling feet. One number drives the whole figure in the order a hand makes on a real safe: the dial spins its graduations onto the fixed index, the spoked handle comes a quarter turn out and throws the bolts through the door's edges, and the door swings clear on its hinge to show the chamber. Nothing is cut away, and the door is one rigid panel rebuilt every frame, so it turns to show its own inner face as it comes round. It runs its own loop with a play/pause control, and once paused you can scrub the door or drive it with the arrow keys.
